dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at CY-3212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 20 December 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on CY-3212 and PT-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
